cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The office plant's dead. I'll interview everyone who watered it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Excellent lead. I'll test the machine. It may be dispensing something harmful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made that coffee yourself. With six sugars.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll prepare six-sugar samples for comparison. We may be dealing with a plant that couldn't handle hospitality.

mechanism: A investigates the plant killed by A drink, correcting test design to move blame from A watering choice to a supposed property of the beverage.
confusable: Generic excuse-making lacks enthusiastic investigative labour directed at hiding A own role.
comparison: Vase alternative uses evidence physically attached to A; plant scene turns known coffee preparation into comparative testing.
seedUse: Coffee/six-sugars seed supplies incriminating details; S03 should use accurate sample comparison to evade the direct conclusion.
